name: wavecenter
description: WaveCenter — the hub of the DEO movement, and the original DEO.

scripts.clickup: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/clickup.mjs
scripts.check:tasks-rls: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/check_tasks_rls.mjs
